## Description

A supplier list with the items each supplies and their price. A purchase order moves Draft → Sent → Part received → Received or Cancelled. Receiving creates batches (P9-003) and receive movements (P9-004).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Receiving part of an order leaves the rest open; receiving all closes it.
- [ ] **AC2.** A sent order prints or exports as PDF with clinic, supplier, items and quantities.
- [ ] **AC3.** Supplier GSTIN (India) or TRN (UAE) is validated by format.
